title: Desert Playground | Pool, Cold Plunge & Arcade
description:
Sunset cocktails by the pool, arcade battles inside, and a fire pit glowing under the desert stars – this Mesa retreat has it all!

- Heated pool & hot tub
- Cold plunge + fire pit
- Arcade, pool table & game room
- Home gym for early risers
- Sports court, putt putt & cornhole
- Sleeps up to 19 guests
review_snippets: The backyard is what really makes this place so fun! The inside is decorated so uniquely and has a ton of space for large groups. I only gave a 4-star review because all of the beds were extremely hard and pillows were cheap and flat. Also the pool was very dirty and never got cleaned while we were there. Otherwise, 5-star place.
Great place lots to  do! well equipped with everything u need! easy check in. property was clean.

This house was amazing! We had a co bachelor group here and everyone was amazed by the house! It has everything! Jeff and Bridget were super friendly and communicative. We couldn’t find a ball pump for the basketballs and they had one delivered that day! Overall a great place to stay for large groups with entertainment for everyone. Could not recommend this place highly enough!

Perfect week with our kids and grandkids, with ample space and activity areas for the kids to be kids: basketball, pickleball, pool, putt-putt, jungle gym, ping pong, air hockey, video games, workout room, and a gorgeous kitchen and areas to gather, eat, and relax.  Loved it and hope to do it again. 😍😍
